title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Entrusted Enforcement

articles.content_en:
Article 1 Where the enforcing court, upon investigation, finds that the person subject to enforcement has no property available for enforcement within its jurisdiction, but has property available for enforcement in other provinces, autonomous regions, or municipalities directly under the Central Government, it may entrust the case to a People's Court at the same level in a different locality for enforcement.
Where the enforcing court truly needs to go to a different locality to enforce a case, it shall obtain the approval of the Higher People's Court in the area where it is located.

Article 2 After a case is entrusted for enforcement, the受托 court shall file the case according to law, and the entrusting court shall, upon receipt of the notice of case filing from the受托 court, handle the case as closed.
Where a court in a different locality is entrusted to assist in inquiries, freezing, sealing, investigation, or service of legal documents, the受托 court shall not file the matter as an entrusted enforcement case, but shall actively provide assistance.

Article 3 For entrusted enforcement, the People's Court at the same level in the place where the subject matter of enforcement is located or where the enforcement act is to be performed shall be the受托 enforcing court. Where there are two or more parcels of property in different localities, the case may be entrusted to the People's Court in the place where the principal property is located.
Where the person subject to enforcement is a soldier on active service or a military unit, the case may be entrusted to the military court that has jurisdiction over it.
Where the subject matter of enforcement is a ship, the case may be entrusted to the maritime court that has jurisdiction.

Article 4 For an entrusted enforcement case, the entrusting court shall directly complete the entrustment procedures with the受托 court, and shall report level by level to the respective Higher People's Courts for record.
For entrustment of specific matters, the relevant procedures for the entrusted matters shall be handled through the comprehensive management platform of the execution command center of the People's Courts.

Article 6 When entrusting enforcement, the entrusting court shall transfer to the受托 court for handling the property of the person subject to enforcement located in a different locality that has already been sealed, seized, or frozen, and shall state this in the letter of entrusted enforcement.
After the entrustment of enforcement, where the entrusting court has already taken measures such as sealing, seizure, or freezing against the property of the person subject to enforcement, such measures shall be deemed to be the sealing, seizure, or freezing measures of the受托 court. Where the受托 court needs to continue the sealing, seizure, or freezing, it shall, by presenting the letter of entrusted enforcement and the notice of case filing, complete the relevant procedures. When renewing the seal or freeze, the original order of sealing and freezing by the entrusting court shall remain.
Where the validity period of measures such as sealing, seizure, or freezing is less than one month at the time of transfer to the受托 court, the entrusting court shall first renew the seal or freeze and then transfer the matter to the受托 court.

Article 7 After receiving the letter of entrusted enforcement, the受托 court shall file the case within 7 days, and shall promptly serve the notice of case filing on the applicant for enforcement through the entrusting court, and shall simultaneously notify the entrusting court in writing of the designated case handler and contact telephone number.
After receiving the aforesaid notice, the entrusting court shall, within 7 days, notify the applicant for enforcement in writing that the case has been entrusted for enforcement, and shall inform the applicant for enforcement that it may directly contact the受托 court regarding enforcement-related matters.

Article 8 Where the受托 court finds that the formalities or materials for entrusted enforcement are incomplete, it may request the entrusting court to complete them. The entrusting court shall complete the supplementary matters within 30 days; if it fails to do so within the aforesaid period, it shall provide a written explanation. Where the entrusting court neither completes the supplementary matters nor explains the reasons, the entrustment shall be deemed withdrawn, and the受托 court may return the entrusted materials to the entrusting court.

Article 9 Where the受托 court returns an entrustment, it shall report level by level to the Higher People's Court in the area where it is located for examination and approval. After the Higher People's Court approves the return, the受托 court shall, within 15 days, return the relevant entrustment formalities and case file materials to the entrusting court and provide a written explanation.
After an entrusted enforcement case is returned, if the受托 court has already filed the case, it shall handle the case as closed. The entrusting court may make a new entrustment after the reasons for the return have been eliminated. Where the case is returned because the entrustment was indeed improper, the entrusting court shall decide to revoke the entrustment and resume enforcement of the case, and report to the Higher People's Court in its area for record.

Article 10 Where, after entrusting a case for enforcement, the entrusting court discovers that there is other property available for enforcement, it shall promptly notify the受托 court. Where the受托 court discovers that the person subject to enforcement has other property available for enforcement outside the jurisdiction of the受托 court, it may directly enforce in the different locality and shall generally not make a new entrustment. Where, under the circumstances, a new entrustment is truly necessary, it shall be handled in accordance with the procedures for entrusted enforcement cases, and the parties to the case shall be notified.

Article 11 Where the受托 court fails to conclude the entrusted case within 6 months, the applicant for enforcement has the right to request the People's Court at the next higher level of the受托 court to elevate the case for enforcement or to designate another court for enforcement. The People's Court at the next higher level shall file the case for examination. If it finds that the受托 court has not enforced without justifiable reasons, it shall order enforcement within a time limit or render a ruling elevating the case for enforcement or designating another court for enforcement.

Article 12 When enforcing in a different locality, assistance in enforcement may be requested from the local court according to the specific circumstances of the case, and the local court shall actively cooperate to ensure the personal safety of enforcement personnel and the protection of enforcement equipment and the subject matter of enforcement from infringement.

Article 14 For the purposes of these Provisions, "different locality" means an area outside the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government in question. For entrusted enforcement within each province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government, the respective Higher People's Courts shall, with reference to these Provisions and in light of actual circumstances, formulate specific measures.
Article 15 After these Provisions come into force, other judicial interpretations concerning entrusted enforcement shall no longer apply.
